name: context-budget
description: Measures a Claude Code session's fixed startup context payload per item at a pinned binary version, including per-tool attribution of the built-in tool pools that /context reports only as totals, derived by A/B deny differencing. Falls back from an SDK meter to a headless /context parser, then to an error rather than a wrong number. Keeps a before/after ledger per lever. Shows a live context breakdown in a pane or above the prompt. Report-only by default; fix applies one approved project trim.

settings_write_ask_enabled.title: Settings-write-ask hook
settings_write_ask_enabled.description: Runs the PreToolUse hook that asks before Write, Edit, and NotebookEdit calls aimed at a Claude Code settings file. On by default. Shell writes and files rendered into place are outside its matcher.

live_display.title: Live context display
live_display.description: Where the live context breakdown shows. pane opens it in a pane when you run /context-budget live; band keeps it above the prompt; off shows nothing and measures nothing. /context-budget live pane, band or off changes it for the session.
